claims.quote: Retroculus acherontos is a cichlid known only from tributaries of the upper rio Tocantins basin in Goiás state, Brazil.
Known only from affluents within the upper rio Tocantins basin draining into the enormous Serra da Mesa hydroelectric reservoir in Goiás state, Brazil.
